note: Alt text used for every image on the MyHealthOpinions caregiver dashboard section (v2.0). In the running section, profile-illustration alt text is translated (translated profile title + ' illustration' / ' completion badge'); language-flag alt text uses the English language name; the 3D heart, carousel backs, background objects, sparkles and emoji are decorative and marked aria-hidden. The Circle of Care (glass heart, orbits, beads, bonds), the reward tokens (heart-coin, rosette star) and the care locket are inline SVG / CSS and decorative; every bead is a button whose accessible name is the item title and its reward state, and the counters carry text labels.
